name: Soft Diffusion
description: One broad soft frontal light wraps the same identity-locked person's face with no hard shadow edge, shot against a soft warm ivory studio ground instead of neutral grey so the whole frame reinforces the light's own "glow" rather than fighting it. Calm, bare, and unhurried.
lighting: Soft frontal wrap light, warm ivory ground
subject: person
prompt: standing in a three-quarter turn against a soft warm ivory seamless studio ground, close chest-up crop centered in frame, pale simple unbranded wardrobe, one broad soft frontal light wrapping the face evenly with no hard shadow edge anywhere on the skin, true warm-neutral skin tone rendered with natural, unsmoothed texture — never waxy or over-retouched, calm unguarded expression, shallow depth of field with soft warm falloff behind the subject, no glossy glamour retouching, wellness-editorial finish with natural film grain
